criteria.hook: first 2 seconds: is the problem clear and does it stop the scroll? (big title + spoken hook)
criteria.avatar: presenter looks like a real person talking: lips match every word, natural face and hands (no morphing, extra fingers, frozen photo), gestures fit the words
criteria.continuity: clean editing: no black / blank / frozen frame anywhere, no glitch or broken cut, the presenter has the SAME outfit and background in every shot, no Flow watermark, nothing cut off at the edges
criteria.voice: one consistent, natural voice (same timbre, accent, pace and loudness in presenter and screen parts), no cut-off words, clicks, robotic words or dead air
criteria.zoho_screens: the Zoho / AI / API steps are SHOWN on screen at the moment they are said, the exact button / field is highlighted, readable on a phone
criteria.pacing: visual change every 2-4 s, no dead time, length fits the content (25-60 s)
criteria.captions: readable, in sync, match the speech exactly, never covering the face or the important part of the screen
criteria.audio: clear voice, music present but always quieter than the voice
criteria.value: the viewer learns a real, correct fix they can follow
criteria.polish: looks as professional as the reference Shorts (layout, fonts, colours, no glitches)
